name: Icebreaker
source:
Yarely was always a loner back home in Florida, but she's never had to experience what total loneliness was like. After settling down in a tiny cabin in the frigid north, two hundred miles from the closest city, the isolation and the cold start to get to her.


To stave off her loneliness, she resorts to making her own girlfriend from ice and snow...

[from [url=https://calico-bun-productions.itch.io/icebreaker]itch.io[/url]]
